findings.element: Org switcher dropdown, result list after the search text is edited
findings.finding: After a search, editing the query leaves the previous query's results listed and clickable, so the list no longer matches the text in the field.
findings.user_impact: An agent who types a new org name and clicks the row they see, without pressing Enter first, switches into the previous search's organization (the wrong customer).
findings.suggested_fix: When the text changes after a search, clear or visibly dim the old results and show a one-line 'Press Enter to search' row until the new search runs.

evidence.action: Searched 'tea' + Enter, then edited the field text without pressing Enter
evidence.observed: List still showed 'TE / Tea Leaf Collective' for the edited query; clicking a row selects it; only the next Enter re-runs the search

findings.element: Administrative functions page, disabled pin icons at 10 pins (lower groups, e.g. Outreach / JS modifications)
findings.finding: At the cap, clicking a disabled pin does nothing, and the only explanation is at the top next to the H1, which is off-screen when the agent is working in the lower part of the 27-link catalog.
findings.user_impact: An agent who scrolled down to pin a page clicks the icon, nothing happens, and they see no cause unless they wait for the native tooltip. This is the dead-control pattern from KF-5.
findings.suggested_fix: Show the 'Unpin a page to add another' error inline next to the row whose disabled pin was clicked (or scroll to/flash the top message on click), so the explanation appears where the click happened.

evidence.action: Pinned up to 10 pages, then clicked a disabled pin icon
evidence.observed: Pin count stayed 10, no response at the click point; cap message renders only next to the page H1 and was recorded as visible only 'when the clicked link is near the top'

gaps: Sidebar unpin: the state map's focus result is cut off ('focus moves to '), so where the agent is left after unpinning in the sidebar is unrecorded
Disabled pin at cap: the map only records the cap message being visible when the clicked link is near the top. Visibility for links in the lower groups (Outreach, JS modifications) was not recorded
Active-row highlight was recorded only for the Organizations pin. Whether other pinned pages (e.g. Health Hub, Syncs history) highlight their sidebar row when opened is not recorded
Org switcher: pressing Enter again while the 'Searching…' spinner is running was not exercised, so it is unknown whether it queues a second search or selects
Failed org switch (error toast) not modelled, so it is unknown whether a failed switch tells the agent which org they are still in
Sidebar at 10 pins needs scrolling: where org-scoped nav (Dashboard, Transactions, Settings) lands at 1280x800 with the promo card present was not captured
